name: patient-worklist
title: Patient Worklist
description: Reusable practice worklist with patient search, visit-status filters, room and provider context, and custom row actions.

"@/components/ui/table" import { WorkflowState } from "@/components/medicn/workflow-state" export type WorklistStatus = "scheduled" | "arrived" | "roomed" | "in-progress" | "completed" | "cancelled" export interface WorklistPatient { /** Encounter/work item ID; the same patient can have multiple encounters. */ id: string patientId: string name: string identifier?: string appointmentTime?: string reason?: string provider?: string location?: string status: WorklistStatus /** Host-supplied workflow priority, never inferred from symptoms. */ priority?: string waitingTime?: string } export interface PatientWorklistProps extends Omit, "title" | "children" | "onSelect"> { patients: WorklistPatient[] title?: React.ReactNode onPatientSelect?: (patient: WorklistPatient) => void renderActions?: (patient: WorklistPatient) => React.ReactNode /** Controlled filters allow URL persistence, saved views, and server-side searching. */ search?: string defaultSearch?: string onSearchChange?: (search: string) => void status?: WorklistStatus | "all" defaultStatus?: WorklistStatus | "all" onStatusChange?: (status: WorklistStatus | "all") => void /** Disable local filtering when the supplied rows are already filtered by a server. */ manualFiltering?: boolean isLoading?: boolean error?: React.ReactNode onRetry?: () => void labels?: Partial> } export function PatientWorklist({ patients, title = "Patient worklist", onPatientSelect, renderActions, search, defaultSearch = "", onSearchChange, status, defaultStatus = "all", onStatusChange, manualFiltering, isLoading, error, onRetry, labels, className, ...props }: PatientWorklistProps) { const id = React.useId() const [internalSearch, setInternalSearch] = React.useState(defaultSearch) const "Arrived", roomed: "Roomed", "in-progress": "In progress", completed: "Completed", cancelled: "Cancelled", all: "All statuses", search: "Search patients, identifiers, providers…", filter: "Visit patients match these filters", loading: "Loading patient worklist…", error: "Could not load patient worklist", retry: "Try again", results: "Results", ...labels } const needle = query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() const rows = manualFiltering ? patients : patients.filter((patient) => (filter === "all" || patient.status === filter) && (!needle || [patient.name,
